title: Touchline cue
description: One timed, machine-readable instruction for a graphics renderer or a viewer app. A renderer shows the cue at match_s for ttl_s seconds, filtered by audience. Every claim a cue makes cites the event ids it rests on; verified says the Verifier checked them.

kind.description: scorebug: score and clock. stat: one team or match number. player_tag: name tag with speed or distance. pass_card / shot_card: metrics of one action. insight: why a moment matters. line: a commentary line. momentum: control vs chaos and pressure state. milestone: a player or team landmark. replay: a replay request. recap: half-time or full-time story.

match_s.description: match clock in seconds; period 2 starts at 2700

frame.description: global 25 Hz tracking frame the cue is anchored to

anchor.description: where on the pitch the graphic attaches, metres

author.description: the service or agent that wrote the cue
